import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import numpy as np
import os

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 10,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'pdf.fonttype': 42,
    'ps.fonttype': 42,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.8,
})

# --- Data (from convergence_table.csv) ---
data = [
    ('LAMBADA',        'retrieval',  -1.0,  0.0167),
    ('HellaSwag',      'reasoning',   0.3,  0.6833),
    ('ARC-Challenge',  'reasoning',   0.6,  0.35),
    ('WinoGrande',     'reasoning',   0.1,  0.95),
    ('ARC-Easy',       'mixed',      -0.7,  0.2333),
    ('MMLU',           'mixed',      -0.7,  0.2333),
    ('BoolQ',          'comprehension', 0.2, 0.7833),
    ('PIQA',           'reasoning',  -0.5,  0.45),
    ('SciQ',           'mixed',       0.1,  0.95),
    ('xstorycloze_en', 'retrieval',  -0.6,  0.35),
]

benchmarks = [d[0] for d in data]
taxonomies = [d[1] for d in data]
rhos = [d[2] for d in data]
pvals = [d[3] for d in data]

# Sort by rho (most negative on top)
order = np.argsort(rhos)
benchmarks = [benchmarks[i] for i in order]
taxonomies = [taxonomies[i] for i in order]
rhos = [rhos[i] for i in order]
pvals = [pvals[i] for i in order]

# Colors by taxonomy
tax_colors = {
    'retrieval': '#0072B2',
    'reasoning': '#E69F00',
    'comprehension': '#2ca02c',
    'mixed': '#999999',
}

# --- Figure ---
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 6.5))

# Background shading (Pattern A)
ax.axvspan(-1.25, 0, color='#d4edda', alpha=0.3, zorder=0)
ax.axvspan(0, 0.85, color='#f8d7da', alpha=0.3, zorder=0)

# Convergence/divergence labels
t_conv = ax.text(-0.62, -0.5, 'convergence\ndirection',
                 fontsize=8, fontstyle='italic', color='#2d6a4f',
                 ha='center', va='bottom')
t_conv.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2.5, foreground='white')])

t_div = ax.text(0.42, -0.5, 'divergence\ndirection',
                fontsize=8, fontstyle='italic', color='#a4161a',
                ha='center', va='bottom')
t_div.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2.5, foreground='white')])

# Vertical dashed line at rho=0
ax.axvline(0, color='#888888', linewidth=0.8, linestyle='--', zorder=1)

# Plot points
y_positions = np.arange(len(benchmarks))

for i, (bench, tax, rho, p) in enumerate(zip(benchmarks, taxonomies, rhos, pvals)):
    color = tax_colors[tax]
    is_lambada = bench == 'LAMBADA'

    if is_lambada:
        ax.plot(rho, i, 'o', color=color, markersize=10, zorder=5,
                markeredgecolor=color, markeredgewidth=1.5)
    else:
        ax.plot(rho, i, 'o', markersize=7, zorder=4,
                markerfacecolor='white', markeredgecolor=color, markeredgewidth=1.5)

    # Horizontal whisker line from 0 to rho
    ax.plot([0, rho], [i, i], '-', color=color, linewidth=1.2, alpha=0.5, zorder=2)

    # Right-side inline text
    if is_lambada:
        label = f'ρ = {rho:.1f}, p = {p:.4f}'
        t = ax.text(0.82, i, label, fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold',
                    color=color, va='center', ha='right')
    else:
        label = f'ρ = {rho:.1f}, p = {p:.4f}'
        t = ax.text(0.82, i, label, fontsize=8, color='#555555',
                    va='center', ha='right')
    t.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2.5, foreground='white')])

# Axes
ax.set_yticks(y_positions)
ax.set_yticklabels(benchmarks)
ax.set_xlim(-1.25, 0.85)
ax.set_ylim(-0.7, len(benchmarks) - 0.3)
ax.set_xlabel('Spearman ρ  (attention-ratio vs. benchmark accuracy)')
ax.invert_yaxis()

# Bold LAMBADA y-tick label
ytick_labels = ax.get_yticklabels()
for label in ytick_labels:
    if label.get_text() == 'LAMBADA':
        label.set_fontweight('bold')
        label.set_color(tax_colors['retrieval'])

# Taxonomy legend (lower right)
legend_handles = [
    mpatches.Patch(color='#0072B2', label='retrieval'),
    mpatches.Patch(color='#E69F00', label='reasoning'),
    mpatches.Patch(color='#2ca02c', label='comprehension'),
    mpatches.Patch(color='#999999', label='mixed'),
]
ax.legend(handles=legend_handles, bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 1), loc='upper left',
          framealpha=0.9, title='taxonomy', title_fontsize=9, fontsize=9)

# Caption note
fig.text(0.5, -0.02,
         'Note: COPA (n=100) excluded from main figure due to insufficient sample size.',
         fontsize=8, fontstyle='italic', color='#777777', ha='center')

# --- Save ---
out_dir = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_2/projects/entrainment_gated_ft/figures/paper'
os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)

pdf_path = os.path.join(out_dir, 'fig2_task_specificity.pdf')
png_path = os.path.join(out_dir, 'fig2_task_specificity.png')

fig.savefig(pdf_path)
fig.savefig(png_path, dpi=300)
plt.close()

print(f'Saved: {pdf_path}')
print(f'Saved: {png_path}')
